10k.note: 10-K describes Caris as a precision medicine / molecular science platform company offering whole exome and whole transcriptome sequencing (WES/WTS) profiling, AI-powered bioinformatics, and a clinico-genomic database. The 'pipeline' references in the 10-K are to the bioinformatics analytical pipeline and to molecular signature / data-asset programs (e.g., breast cancer prognostic signatures), not to proprietary therapeutic drug candidates.

website.note: Pipeline page exists but is JavaScript-rendered and could not be extracted via WebFetch. Description references 'currently planned molecular science-based solutions' (i.e. diagnostic assays / signatures), not drug therapeutics.

ctgov.note: Only 2 records list Caris-related sponsors; both are TERMINATED or WITHDRAWN, and lead sponsors are external academic / Debiopharm / Georgetown University - Caris was a diagnostic collaborator, not the asset owner.

commercial_product.note: Caris commercial offerings are diagnostic / molecular profiling assays, not therapeutics.
products: MI Cancer Seek (FDA-authorized comprehensive WES/WTS tissue profiling)
MI Profile / MI Tumor Seek Hybrid (tissue-based molecular profiling)
Caris Discovery / data-asset partnerships with biopharma

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Of the 2 ctgov records returned for the Caris query, 1 was TERMINATED and 1 was WITHDRAWN (lead sponsors Debiopharm International SA and Georgetown University); neither was a Caris-owned therapeutic asset.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Diagnostics-only / precision-medicine services company - no proprietary therapeutic pipeline. Caris develops and commercializes molecular profiling assays (MI Cancer Seek, Caris Assure, MI Tumor Seek Hybrid) and operates a clinico-genomic data platform for biopharma partners. The company does not own or develop drug candidates. Per scoping rule for diagnostics / lab-services issuers, pipeline is empty.
